searchMetadata.description: Information about the listing/search page being crawled

query.description: The search query or category term, if applicable

searchUrl.description: URL of the current listing/search page

products.description: List of product URLs discovered on the listing page. This is the primary output of a crawler — detailed product fields are NOT extracted here.

url.description: Absolute URL to the product detail page (must include protocol and domain)

productId.description: Unique identifier for the product (e.g., ASIN, SKU, item_id) — extract if visible in the URL or markup

name.description: Product name as displayed in the listing (optional, aids debugging)

pagination.description: Pagination information for crawling additional pages

hasNextPage.description: Whether there is a next page available

nextPageUrl.description: Absolute URL to the next page of results (must include protocol and domain)
